item.title: Coinbase Price Projections Slashed By Analysts Ahead of Earnings
item.description: Analysts from JPMorgan, Cantor Fitzgerald, and Citi remain bullish on Coinbase, but have all cut their price targets as Bitcoin dives deeper.

item.title: Bitcoin Slides as Fed Rate Cut Doubts Follow Strong Jobs Report
item.description: Bitcoin continued falling Wednesday after a strong U.S. jobs report dampened hopes that the Federal Reserve would lower interest rates in March.

item.title: Bitcoin Exchange Paxful Must Pay $4 Million Over Prostitution, Money Laundering Charges
item.description: Paxful signed a plea deal saying it should pay a $112 million fine for its crimes. But the DOJ determined it could only afford to pay $4 million.

item.title: Bitcoin Transfer, New Ransom Demand Surface in Nancy Guthrie Abduction Case: Reports
item.description: Investigators released footage of a suspect in the Nancy Guthrie case amid reports of a Bitcoin transfer and new ransom demand.

item.title: XRP Is Ripple's 'North Star' Amid Ambitions to Build $1 Trillion Firm, Says CEO
item.description: Brad Garlinghouse said his company has the opportunity to reach a $1 trillion valuation, while centering its ambitions around XRP.

item.title: AI’s Builders Are Sending Warning Signals—Some Are Walking Away
item.description: Senior researchers are leaving Elon Musk’s xAI as Anthropic discloses new safety findings and AI insiders issue unusually blunt warnings.

item.title: Coinbase Launches Wallet for AI Agents With Built-In Guardrails
item.description: The company says its sandboxed, self-custodial design keeps private keys isolated as the autonomous bot boom continues.

item.title: Thailand's SEC Clears Path for Crypto-Linked Derivatives
item.description: Thailand will allow digital assets to back regulated derivatives, deepening crypto’s role in its capital markets.

item.title: What to Expect for Bitcoin and Crypto Ahead of This Week's Inflation Data
item.description: Investors are focused on January’s CPI release after stronger-than-expected jobs data forced a repricing of rate expectations.

item.title: US Banks Urge Regulator to Slow Crypto-Linked Charters Amid Rule Overhaul
item.description: The warning comes as crypto firms push for deeper access to the U.S. banking system, heightening tensions over unresolved regulatory gaps.
